reddit.title: Introducing a New Materials System for Building in Provincia
reddit.body: We're excited to share a significant update to our building mechanics! Instead of a single cost badge, each build tile now displays a comprehensive materials list. You can easily see what materials you have stored versus what is required, with any shortages clearly highlighted. This change enhances your building experience by providing clarity on resource needs. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/materials-instead-of-cost-badges?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=materials-instead-of-cost-badges

steam.title: Update: Enhanced Materials System for Building
steam.body: We're pleased to introduce an improved materials system in Provincia! Each build tile now features a dedicated materials sheet that clearly outlines stored versus required resources, with shortages highlighted for your convenience. This update aims to enhance your building experience and make resource management more intuitive. Learn more about this update in our devtalk: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/materials-instead-of-cost-badges?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=materials-instead-of-cost-badges
